summary: Full-stack end-to-end test of RUI Explorer (IVASS insurance intermediary portal). Backend pytest suite: 20/20 passing on external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend: all critical user flows exercised via Playwright — portal search, filters, result click → detail drawer with all expected cells + Pro-gate overlay for non-pro users, freemium gate for guests, email/password login, AI assistant (Gemini) query + response, Stripe checkout redirect confirmed, dashboard KPIs/charts populated.

minor.issue: Endpoint accepts guest (unauthenticated) requests and returns a valid Stripe checkout_url, but the transaction is stored with user_id=null so no user is ever granted is_pro on payment success. Frontend does gate the Pricing UI behind auth (via the pricing page), but the server-side endpoint should also require auth (401) to prevent orphan Stripe sessions and wasted API calls. See server.py:538.

action_items: OPTIONAL (soft finding): require authentication on POST /api/payments/checkout — return 401 if get_current_user(request) returns None, to prevent guest Stripe sessions that can never grant is_pro.
OPTIONAL: address Chrome console warning "<link rel=preload> uses an unsupported `as` value" in public/index.html or preload directives.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 646 lines and contains all routes; consider splitting into routers/ (auth, search, payments, ai) once app grows further.
Guest checkout endpoint allows anonymous Stripe sessions (server.py:538-564) — soft security/UX issue only.
IntermediaryDrawer.jsx (292 lines) is close to the 700-line threshold; still acceptable but watch for growth.
All interactive elements have data-testid — testability is excellent.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projection everywhere I checked (verified in test_no_mongo_object_id).
Async/await patterns are consistent across backend routes.
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via lib/api.js — no hardcoded URLs found.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + frontend fully verified against external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_rui_api.py for regression. If backend endpoints change response shapes (e.g. /intermediary wraps data in {intermediary,usage}; /map returns {points,total_clusters}; /stats uses by_province & top_mandates), update the tests accordingly. Guest quota is shared across sessions from the same guest_id cookie, so pytest fixtures use the authenticated session for all quota-consuming endpoints.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Only one soft finding: /api/payments/checkout accepts guest requests (see server.py:538 — get_current_user is called but result is optional and not enforced). Mitigation: add `if not current: raise HTTPException(401)` in create_checkout, and/or hide checkout buttons in Pricing.jsx for logged-out users (redirect to /login first).
